title: Hustler's Totem
description: Reskins the Totem of Undying to look like Ninja from Your Only Move Is Hustle.
body:
A resource pack that reskins the Totem of Undying to look like the Ninja from Your Only Move Is Hustle blocking. Also includes a new sound effect to match.

Your Only Move Is Hustle is a turn-based fighting game created by ivysly and is available on [Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/2212330/Your_Only_Move_Is_HUSTLE/) and [itch](https://ivysly.itch.io/your-only-move-is-hustle).
